_comment: Standing contracts for the vertical slice (systems.md §3). 'trigger' must be one of: shaken_down, peril_survived, turned_home — the road outcomes a call-in can ride. A demand_daylight is always honoured and can strand you; a demand_silver defaults when the purse is short. terms/demand/penalty are the chronicle's words — the sim never writes prose. All numbers first-pass; argue in playtests. sojourners_right is signed at Ugarit deliberately: a trade-mission arrangement made before departure, which is why its seal access works at the far guild hall.

contracts.terms: carriage silver every leg, callable wherever Urtenu's factors fly their sail
contracts.demand: twelve shekels, weighed on the spot
contracts.penalty: the purse emptied, two of media seized against the debt, and the consignment torn up

contracts.holder: the temple of the storm god
contracts.terms: the god's hand over the bad crossings, tithed in daylight each time it is needed
contracts.demand: three days of light, owed to the god who kept you

contracts.terms: standing at the Alashiyan guild hall, arranged from Ugarit before the sail
contracts.demand: four shekels of standing dues at the turn for home
contracts.penalty: what the purse held, taken; the right lapses and the guild hall's door closes
